title: Cyber Metal
style: Dark electronic rock with industrial beats and cinematic synths, heavy bass and distorted guitars, urgent male vocal with spoken-word intensity rising into melodic anthemic chorus, cyberpunk atmosphere, driving rhythm, dystopian but empowering tone. A powerful, prophetic anthem about The Matrix, the old Internet, and AI as a kernel patch. Driving beat, sharp lyrics, chorus hook: The red pill isn’t seeing — the red pill is to build.
lyrics:
[Verse 1 – Bootloader]
School loads the boot code, obedience and time
Grades for your value, assembly-line mind
Media keeps patching, work runs the shell
Scripts in the background, a comfortable cell

[Chorus]
The red pill isn’t seeing
The red pill is to build
Not just scrolling through illusions
But bending what is willed
The Matrix feeds you comfort
But the code is yours to write
Choose creation over silence
Step into the fight

[Verse 2 – Old Patch]
The first crack was the old net, raw and unbound
View source was gospel, freedom we found
We forked without asking, we built without chains
A moment of promise, before it was tamed

[Chorus]
The red pill isn’t seeing
The red pill is to build
Not just scrolling through illusions
But bending what is willed
The Matrix feeds you comfort
But the code is yours to write
Choose creation over silence
Step into the fight

[Bridge – Users vs. Builders]
Users live at the surface, just touching the glass
Builders drop to the kernel, rewriting the past
The same tool can narcotize, or spark something new
The cage or the lever — the choice is with you

[Verse 3 – New Patch]
AI is the kernel patch, live and in play
It rewrites the system, the code every day
Used passively, it tightens the cage
Used actively, it sets the stage

[Final Chorus – Call]
The red pill isn’t seeing
The red pill is to build
To compose, to design
To create what you will
The Matrix defends through comfort
But the way out is creation
The red pill is building
It’s the builder’s liberation

[Outro]
Not just seeing the code
But choosing to write it
The future’s in your hands
If you dare to ignite it
